memo.title: Sprint 12 Status
memo.summary: The team discussed the current sprint status, noting that the auth module is blocked pending an API fix. John committed to fixing the API by April 7, and a review meeting was planned for next Monday. The release date was moved to April 10.
blockers: Auth module blocked pending API fix
next_steps: John will fix the API by April 7
Schedule a review meeting next Monday with John and Priya

meetings.title: API Fix Sync
meetings.purpose: Confirm that John has completed the API fix and address any immediate issues

what_was_discussed: The team reviewed the status of Sprint 12.
A blocker was identified: the authentication module is blocked pending an API fix.
John committed to resolving the API issue by April 7.
what_was_decided: The project release date is officially pushed to April 10.
what_to_follow_up: Confirm completion of the API fix by John, due April 7.
Ensure the review meeting with John and Priya has been scheduled for the upcoming Monday.
open_questions: Is the API fix complete and has it successfully unblocked the auth module?
Has the design and API integration review meeting been scheduled?
Who is assigned to the 'Update release date' task and has it been completed?
risks_to_watch: The April 10 release date is critically dependent on the timely completion of the API fix. Any delay puts the release at risk.
Potential integration issues between the new API and Priya's designs may arise during the review, which could impact the timeline.
suggested_agenda: Status update on 'Fix the API' task from John.
Confirmation from Priya that the auth module work is now unblocked.
Review status of 'Schedule review meeting' task from Alice.
Assign owner for the 'Update release date' task.
Re-evaluate confidence in meeting the April 10 release date.
